verdict.rationale: Published support SLAs and escalation paths per plan tier are a fair question for a hosting platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack contains no documentation of guaranteed response times, tiered support levels or escalation procedures. The only support-related items are anecdotal reports of support fixing an issue within 48 hours, which are not a documented guarantee.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I know the guaranteed support response times and escalation paths for my plan tier
